evidence.title: Tremor – Copy-and-Paste Tailwind CSS UI Components for Charts and Dashboards
GitHub - tremorlabs/tremor: Copy & Paste React components to build modern web applications.

name: Tremor
summary: Open-source React components and blocks for building charts and dashboards with Tailwind CSS.
description: A copy-and-paste React component library and npm package for charts and dashboards, built with Tailwind CSS, Radix UI and Recharts. It covers visualizations (area, bar, combo, line, donut, spark charts, trackers, bar lists), inputs (calendar, date picker, slider, select, switch) and UI pieces (badge, dialog, drawer, table, tabs, toast, tooltip), plus 250+ blocks and templates.
contains: charts: area, bar, combo, line, donut, spark, tracker, bar list, category bar
inputs: calendar, date range picker, dropdown menu, slider, switch, select, textarea
built on React, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI and Recharts
